name: Ember EDL Sidecars
description: Read-only, authenticated endpoint (GET /EmberEDL/{itemId}) that returns the .edl file sitting next to a movie or episode (Movie.mkv -> Movie.edl). Ember Player uses it to apply skip and mute filters. Respects each user's library access and never modifies media.
overview: Serves .edl skip/mute sidecars to Ember Player.
